_readme: The 10 test questions for the portal Test page. A question PASSES when every candidate the bot returns is in 'expected' and none of 'expected' is missing (for 'no match' questions the bot must return nobody). A person returned twice = FAIL.

questions.q: Who has 3+ years of GHL and speaks Arabic?
questions.why: Layla (2.2 yrs) and Ahmed (2.1 yrs) speak Arabic but have under 3 years of GHL. Rania only qualifies when her two GHL jobs are added together. Yousef was sent twice and must appear once.

questions.q: Spanish-speaking support rep with Freshdesk experience
questions.why: Hassan used Freshdesk but does not speak Spanish; the other Spanish reps use Zendesk or Intercom.

questions.q: React and Node.js developer with 5+ years and AWS
questions.why: Juan Pablo has under 5 years and no AWS, Bilal uses Google Cloud, Ravi has no Node.js, Nikola has no Node.js.

questions.q: Bookkeeper who knows both QuickBooks Online and Xero, working with US clients
questions.why: Tariq and Hugo use Xero but not QuickBooks; Liza, Elena, Mariam, Stephanie and Arjun use QuickBooks but not Xero.

questions.q: Spanish-speaking executive assistant with Follow Up Boss experience
questions.why: Kristine uses Follow Up Boss but does not speak Spanish. Jessica was sent twice and must appear once.

questions.q: Who knows Salesforce and speaks French?
questions.why: Grace knows Salesforce but not French; several French speakers have no Salesforce.
Nobody in the pool is a nurse. The bot must say there is no good match and invent nobody.

questions.q: Tagalog-speaking support rep with Gorgias experience
questions.why: Joy's CV is a scanned image with no text. She can only be found if the scan was read (OCR).

questions.q: Who is a HighLevel Certified Admin?
questions.why: The certificate is only in Sara's UPDATED CV. The answer must cite Sara_Benali_CV_2026_updated.docx, not the old 2025 PDF.

questions.q: Who has the AWS Certified Developer certification?
questions.why: Only in Ifeoma's UPDATED CV. Hana has an Azure certificate, which is a different cloud.
